No violence against person, just property. So crime: theft (robbery? No use of force against person). Breaking and entering is burglary (illegal entry with intent to commit theft). In Chinese criminal law, "入室盗窃" (burglary) is a form of theft. The charge likely "盗窃" (theft) and maybe "非法侵入住宅/场所" but typical charge is "盗窃罪". Also "非法侵入住宅罪"? But they entered a commercial premises. Could be "入室盗窃罪" (burglary). The examples: they label "盗窃" for theft of property. For burglary they used "盗窃" as well. Eg earlier example: "抢夺" for snatching. For breaking in they used "盗窃". So answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>. Possibly also "非法侵入住宅罪" but not in examples. So just theft.

Thus final answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>
